description: This file contains unit tests for the HostValidator class, verifying its behavior in host validation scenarios including allowlist/blocked list checks and host resolution logic.

classes.name: HostValidatorTest
classes.description: Test suite for verifying the behavior of the HostValidator class, including host validation correctness, resolution, allow/block list handling, and exception generation.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes mocks and default configurations before each test method runs, setting up the testing environment for host validation.

methods.name: testAllowedBlockedHosts
methods.description: Verifies that hosts configured as allowed—such as specific IP addresses and localhost—are accepted by the validator.

methods.name: expectValidationFailsForInvalidHost
methods.description: Checks that an invalid hostname triggers validation failure and proper exception details.

methods.name: expectConfiguredAllowedAndBlockedHostIsAllowed
methods.description: Ensures that a host explicitly configured as allowed passes validation.

methods.name: expectConfiguredBlockedHostIsBlocked
methods.description: Ensures that a host explicitly configured as blocked fails validation.

methods.name: expectBlockedHostIsBlocked
methods.description: Verifies that hosts resolving to blocked addresses, such as the loopback address, are correctly rejected.

methods.name: resolveHost
methods.description: Helper method to resolve a host name to an InetAddress array, optionally using custom address bytes.

methods.name: getHostValidatorWithAllowlist
methods.description: Creates a HostValidator instance with a specified allowlist of hostnames.

methods.name: getHostValidatorWithCustomResolver
methods.description: Creates a HostValidator with a custom host resolution strategy, optionally with an allowlist.

methods.name: assertValid
methods.description: Helper method to assert that a validation result is valid.
